purpose: No section highlights what is new.

name: Lookbook

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if any outfit names an item not in the catalogue.

name: Size guide

name: Ordering, delivery, returns and exchange
purpose: Ordering, delivery and return rules are not stated.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if any policy term is added that the Requester did not supply.

name: Customer reviews

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if any review text, name or star rating is added or altered.

name: Store links tap targets
purpose: Audit R-6: the phone and Instagram links in the store section measure 138x22 and 170x22 at 360px, under the 44x44px minimum.

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if either link is still under 44px tall at 360px after one retry, or if any text or href in the store section changes.

completion_check: At 360px the phone link and the Instagram link each measure at least 44x44px; link text and hrefs are unchanged; no horizontal overflow at 360px and 1280px; no JS errors; nothing else in the section changes.

name: Head cleanup

envelope.stop_loss: Stop if the head still has more than one <title> after one retry, or if the viewport meta or any nav link changes.
